summary_md: **DAIR.AI ([@dair_ai](https://x.com/dair_ai/status/2115987068761628740))** highlights **RuHarness** ([arXiv 2610.36826](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36826)), which co-evolves the rubric alongside the harness by mining behavioral criteria from trajectories and targeting edits at the most relevant unresolved weakness, beating the strongest harness-evolution baseline by 4.5 points with Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and 5.3 with GLM-4.7-Flash ([DAIR summary](https://academy.dair.ai/papers/when-the-critic-falls-behind-co-evolving-rubrics-and-harnesses-for-continual-age-2610.368)).
relevance: Self-improving harnesses tested on local-size models.
